title: Product Operations Director
text:
Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Director of Product Operations to oversee daily product operations, manage the team, and optimize internal processes. This role requires close collaboration across departments to ensure the orderly progression of projects, address operational challenges, and contribute to the achievement of business objectives.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in team management, workflow optimization, and collaborating with senior leadership.

Responsibilities

Oversee daily product operations, ensuring that all tasks are completed according to plan.

Manage team performance, assign responsibilities, and support the professional development of team members.

Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to coordinate task prioritization.

Evaluate existing processes and implement optimizations or improvements where necessary.

Monitor operational performance and provide regular progress reports to management.

Identify potential project risks and work with the team to resolve issues as they arise.

Support product planning and assist the team in achieving business goals.

Maintain effective communication with internal teams and various stakeholders.

Requirements

20+ years of experience in product operations, business operations, or a related field.

Proven track record in team management and overseeing multiple projects.

In-depth understanding of product strategy and operational processes.

Experience in optimizing workflows and managing team performance.

Excellent communication, organizational, coordination, and problem-solving skills.

Strong cross-functional collaboration abilities, with the capacity to effectively navigate shifting priorities.

Experience in the Fintech or financial services industry is highly preferred.

Pay: $285,000.00 - $355,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote
